about: What every file of the Linux release is, under which license, and where its source is (Milestone 158).

hydo-release (hydo/crates/hydo-release) checks this list (cargo test -p hydo-release), writes the release's LICENSE, licenses/ and THIRD-PARTY.md from it, and builds the sources archive; the format is described in hydo/crates/hydo-release/src/lib.rs and docs/RELEASING.md.
Third-party license texts are copied from each component's source archive into hydo/dist/licenses/<archive name>/.

rust_overrides.name: libyaml-safer
rust_overrides.reason: its Cargo.toml has no license field, only license-file = LICENSE-MIT (the MIT license)

components.name: hydo
components.note: hydo's own programs, scripts and documents. guest/hydo_fc and guest/hvx_seedrng are hydo's C programs (hydo/onboard/hydo_fc.c, hv/hvx/images/hvx_seedrng.c) compiled statically with the pinned musl gcc (docs/BUILD-PINS.md); they contain musl 1.2.6 and GCC 13.2.0's libgcc (below). The rest of hydo's source is its repository at the commit `hydo --version` names.

components.name: hvx kernel module (source)
components.license: GPL-2.0-only AND (GPL-2.0-only WITH Linux-syscall-note OR Apache-2.0)
components.note: The kernel module's source, built on the user's machine by `hydo module build`. hvx.c is GPL-2.0-only; hvx_abi.h, the ioctl interface, is GPL-2.0-only WITH Linux-syscall-note OR Apache-2.0 (licenses/hydo/hv/hvx/LICENSE.md).

components.name: Rust standard library
components.note: The standard library (std, core, alloc and their dependencies) of the pinned Rust 1.90.0 is compiled into every Rust program. COPYRIGHT-library.html is the toolchain's list of the library's third-party code and licenses. Its source is rustc-1.90.0-src.tar.xz (sha256 6bfeaddd90ffda2f063492b092bfed925c4b8c701579baf4b1316e021470daac).

components.name: musl C library (Rust's x86_64-unknown-linux-musl target)
components.note: Rust's musl target links its self-contained libc.a and crt objects (musl 1.2.3) statically into every Linux program.

components.name: LLVM libunwind and compiler-rt (Rust's musl target)
components.note: Rust's musl target links LLVM's libunwind and compiler-rt's crtbegin/crtend objects statically (their source is src/llvm-project in rustc-1.90.0-src.tar.xz).

components.name: Protocol Buffers well-known type descriptors
components.note: hydo-grpc-gen carries the descriptors of google/protobuf/*.proto (Protocol Buffers, Google) as protobuf-go 1.35.2 builds them, recorded in wkt.pb.

components.name: Linux kernel
components.note: guest/bzImage and the modules under guest/modules/ (and the modules inside guest/initramfs-kafka.cpio.gz) are nixpkgs's linux_6_6 output byte for byte (checked against cache.nixos.org in Milestone 158). nixpkgs applies its patches pkgs/os-specific/linux/kernel/{bridge-stp-helper,request-key-helper,randstruct-provide-seed-5.19}.patch and generates the configuration (upstream/linux-6.6.35-nixpkgs.config, the exact .config) from pkgs/os-specific/linux/kernel/common-config.nix. The initramfs (assembled by hv/hvx/images/build-linux.sh section 2l.6) holds this kernel's modules, busybox 1.37.0 and hydo's init script.

components.name: BusyBox

nix.note: Substituted from cache.nixos.org (deriver rnr9smwj912vyija4w0w7pv9va3zb4h3-busybox-static-x86_64-unknown-linux-musl-1.37.0.drv), built by nixpkgs's pkgsStatic.busybox recipe (pkgs/os-specific/linux/busybox) of a nixpkgs revision newer than the one above that was not recorded.

components.note: A static musl build; it contains musl 1.2.6 (below). The source archive is busybox.net's (its sha256 matches busybox.net's .sha256 file); the recipe that configured it is nixpkgs's busybox recipe, of which upstream/nixpkgs-89c49874fb15.tar.gz holds the 1.36.1 version.

components.name: musl C library
components.note: Statically linked into busybox and into hydo's two static helpers.

components.name: GCC runtime libraries (libgcc, libgcc_s, libstdc++)

nix.note: The pinned static musl gcc that compiled hydo_fc and hvx_seedrng (its libgcc is linked into them).

components.note: Under the GCC Runtime Library Exception; included with its source for completeness.

components.name: GNU C Library
components.note: nixpkgs patches glibc 2.39 to the 2.39 branch (pkgs/development/libraries/glibc/2.39-master.patch) and applies its own patches from that directory. Parts of glibc are under other licenses (LICENSES).

components.name: e2fsprogs
components.note: mke2fs and debugfs run on the user's machine with their own loader (libexec/faketime, libexec/bin/debugfs); the programs are GPL-2.0, libext2fs and libe2p LGPL-2.0, libcom_err and libss MIT-style (NOTICE).

components.name: libfaketime
components.note: The source archive is the fixed-output directory nixpkgs fetched from GitHub, packed as a .tar.gz (sorted, fixed times).

components.name: Redis (static, for the Redis example)
components.license: BSD-3-Clause AND BSD-2-Clause AND MIT AND BSL-1.0
components.note: Built from its derivation (docs/BUILD-PINS.md); it bundles Lua 5.1.5, hiredis, linenoise, hdr_histogram and fpconv (their texts are under deps/), and links jemalloc 5.3.0 and musl 1.2.3 statically.

components.name: musl C library (nixpkgs static, in Redis)
